name: Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny: Generation of C.E.
summary:
Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny: Generation of C.E. is a strategy game, developed by Tom Create and published by Bandai, which was released in Japan in 2005.

Generation of C.E. is a strategy game similar to the Super Robot Wars and SD Gundam G Generation series, however it differs in its use of normal, instead of SD, proportions. Units move around on a hex-based map, while attacks are represented by 3D animations. The game is split into missions; before missions, a briefing introduces winning and losing conditions to the player. As the game progresses, more characters and mobile suits become available to the player. Unlocked mobile suits can be modified before missions.
